verdict.rationale: Kick's Platform API reference pages embed complete per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 documents, so a machine-readable spec exists. However, it is published only as fragments inside GitBook pages rather than as one downloadable file. Probes of the standard openapi.json and swagger.json paths returned 404, and the API is gated per organization. Missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI file at a stable URL, public (non-gated) access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Kick documents a Platform API whose reference pages embed complete per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 documents
The spec is published as per-operation fragments inside the GitBook pages rather than one downloadable file
The API reference renders GitBook's OpenAPI explorer with a "Test it" runner per operation
